page.layout: One printed page, a title page: title lines at the top in centred blocks, a fleuron woodcut in the middle, place and year at the foot.
page.notes: Fleuron woodcut (decorative ornament of stylised flowers and scrolls) between the title and the place line; not transcribed as text. A manuscript mark (a letter or flourish) sits at the upper right, handwriting, not transcribed. The title's word "IVLII" is printed with I for J and V for U, as in the original capitals; "PRIORES" shows a Q-like R form in the print and is copied as printed. Reading "PRIQRES" for "PRIORES" is my best reading of the scan.
